ns2:course.label: The Age of the Renaissance
ns2:course.description: An introduction to the cultural history of Europe in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, embracing the Renaissance movements in Italy and in Northern Europe. Same as MDVL 346 and RLST 346. Prerequisite: One year of college history.
